svg.title: Revenue per employee
svg.desc: 57 company comparisons in the 2026 view. Headcount uses a logarithmic scale from 200 to 2.5 million. The vertical axis shows revenue per employee in millions of dollars. Bubble area represents revenue. Observations mix reporting periods, estimates, and projections.
